metadata.project_name: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) Honest Clinical Screening Research Platform
metadata.validation_policy: Untouched 20% holdout test sets for questionnaires; Leave-One-Site-Out (LOSO) CV for fMRI brain connectivity.
metadata.leakage_rule: Strict prohibition of total score or derived label features; strict fold-internal harmonization.

leakage_demonstration.audit_verdict: Total score column ('result' or 'Qchat-10-Score') is a direct mathematical derivation of the diagnostic cutoff and MUST be excluded from clinical screening feature sets.

inflated_random_evaluation.evaluation_type: 5-Fold Random Split CV (INFLATED - Leaks site-specific scanner variance)

top_predictive_connections.connection_label: ROI_41 (Default Mode Network (DMN)) <-> ROI_62 (Default Mode Network (DMN))
ROI_18 (Limbic Network) <-> ROI_31 (Ventral Attention / Salience Network)
ROI_75 (Frontoparietal Control Network) <-> ROI_153 (Default Mode Network (DMN))
ROI_80 (Ventral Attention / Salience Network) <-> ROI_185 (Ventral Attention / Salience Network)

abide_brain_benchmarks.pipeline: CPAC (filt_global: band-pass filtered 0.01-0.1Hz, global signal regression)
